product: C++ SDK for Zerobus Ingest Connector
tagline: Now in Beta, enabling high-throughput data ingestion.
what_it_does: The C++ SDK for the Zerobus Ingest connector allows users to ingest records directly into Unity Catalog Delta tables using a high-throughput gRPC client. It supports multiple data formats including JSON and Protocol Buffers, catering to various ingestion needs. The SDK is designed for high-volume applications, leveraging persistent connections to optimize performance. Additionally, it integrates seamlessly with existing Databricks infrastructure, facilitating efficient data workflows.
why_it_matters: This SDK significantly enhances data ingestion capabilities for organizations, allowing them to handle large volumes of data efficiently and in real-time. By supporting multiple data formats and high-throughput ingestion, businesses can improve their data processing speed and reduce latency, leading to better decision-making and operational efficiency. This is particularly beneficial for industries reliant on real-time data analytics and monitoring.
plain_summary: A new C++ SDK for the Zerobus Ingest connector is now available, enabling efficient data ingestion into Databricks.

capabilities.title: High-Throughput Ingestion
capabilities.desc: Utilizes gRPC for persistent connections, optimizing data ingestion speeds.

capabilities.title: Multiple Data Formats
capabilities.desc: Supports JSON, Protocol Buffers, and Apache Arrow Flight for flexible data handling.

capabilities.title: Integration with Unity Catalog
capabilities.desc: Directly ingests records into Unity Catalog Delta tables for streamlined data management.

capabilities.title: OpenTelemetry Support
capabilities.desc: Ingests OpenTelemetry data without custom libraries, simplifying monitoring setups.

prerequisites: Access to Databricks workspace with Zerobus Ingest connector enabled.
Knowledge of gRPC and data formats like JSON and Protocol Buffers.
use_cases: Real-time data ingestion from IoT devices.
High-volume data processing for analytics applications.
Integration of telemetry data into data lakes.
Batch processing of data using Apache Arrow Flight.
limitations: Currently in Beta, may have limited support and features.
Concurrency quotas apply due to persistent connections in gRPC.
Not all features may be available in all regions.
